summary: Construction Partners, Inc. filed an 8-K to report an amendment to its existing Term Loan B Credit Agreement. The amendment refinances outstanding term loans and adds $300 million of incremental term loans. The interest rate margin was reduced by 0.25% if the net leverage ratio remains below 2.95x, with Level 1 pricing effective until September 30, 2026. The loans mature November 1, 2031, with quarterly amortization of 0.25%. A six-month repricing protection period was reset with a 1.00% prepayment premium. A routine debt refinancing; no special situation event.
